text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—I'm taking a slight detour on the way 
back. Go on ahead without me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What is it? Curious about what your 
master is doing?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Quite the brave little puppy, following me 
around without a leash. If you want to tag 
along, do whatever you like.

Following Sirius Symboli, I entered a 
rather curious shop called "A Library 
Where You Can Drink Coffee."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's called a library, but it only houses 
Western books. In other words, only 
extreme eccentrics ever come here.
choice_data_list: You read foreign books, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"It's part of my language studies. If 
you're going to compete on the world 
stage, it's a necessary skill, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Though by now, it's pretty much half a 
hobby.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Different countries have different common 
sense and taboos. Thanks to that, reading 
never gets boring.

I nodded, thinking, "I see." Perhaps her 
slightly wild behavior and speech were 
influenced by that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Is the seat in the back open?

text_block_list.name: Shop Bartender
text_block_list.text: Yes, just as usual.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Black tea in 30 minutes, please. Nilgiri, 
straight.

text_block_list.name: Shop Bartender
text_block_list.text: Understood. See you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...And that's that. I'll stay until I'm 
satisfied, so do whatever you want after.

After she left, I looked around at the 
books in the shop. Naturally, not a single 
one looked familiar to me.
choice_data_list:
(If I'm going to stand by her side, I need 
to—)

text_block_list.name: Shop Bartender
text_block_list.text:
Is there a particular book you are looking 
for?
choice_data_list:
…Things like books on the climate and 
culture overseas, for example

text_block_list.name: Shop Bartender
text_block_list.text: Of course we do. Please come this way.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh.

Enveloped in the deep aroma of coffee and 
old books, I spent a few hours reading...

text_block_list.name: Shop Bartender
text_block_list.text: Working hard, are we?

Looking up, I saw the Master smiling 
beside me. And on the table sat a 
delicious-looking cake set.

text_block_list.name: Shop Bartender
text_block_list.text:
"...I received a rather peculiar order, 
you see. 'Don't say a word, just leave it 
there casually.'"
choice_data_list: (Without a doubt, it's coming from her—)

text_block_list.text:
I never expected such a surprise. Unable 
to stop my cheeks from softening into a 
smile, I bring a piece of cake to my 
mouth.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah... What a simpleton.

In the end, the two of us lost ourselves 
in reading until closing time. Walking 
side by side on the way back, we headed 
toward the academy with light steps.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Did you enjoy today's walk 
that much?

Sirius Symboli smiled knowingly. Facing 
her, I smiled and nodded...

Sirius Symboli smiled knowingly. Facing 
her, I smiled and nodded...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Turns out my little puppy gets rather 
lonely. Though if she wanted to go, she 
could've just gone on her own.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Aren't you admirable? Not bad. Fine, 
I'll bring you along again sometime if I 
feel like it.

Her tail gives my leg a light thwack. 
Gladly accepting the gentle tap, the two 
of us make our leisurely way home.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I don't care much for sweets. I'll eat a 
scone, at most.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's just a single bite of cake, 
I suppose I could manage it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"If you wanna return the favor, you're 
eating the rest."
